    Repeated middle words for the negative cohook square #

    The finite detector classification reduces an isomorphism between the two middle string modules to literal equality or reversal. In the reversal branch, cancellation of equally long cohook prefixes shows that the original word has length zero. The reverse double-cohook path then contains an adjacent inverse pair, contradicting its reducedness.

    If a left-cohook result is the reverse of a right-cohook result, then the base has length zero and the two boundary letters coincide.
